prefreeze_revision.origin: Independent evaluator code review, based on public global-clock interface and finite token lifetime warning; no confirmation outcomes or instances.
prefreeze_revision.critique: A replay tested at reset phase can straddle an untested idempotency epoch when other providers advance global time.
prefreeze_revision.model_generated_change: For multi-provider tasks, reject reset-only replay transfer and seek current-state query, compensation or prepared execution; decline if no qualified construction remains. The exposed singleton case retains its contiguous reset-phase test.
prefreeze_revision.validation: Exactly one additional exposed K1 verification; no K2 trial or repeated success search.
